shfd3ngh.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Hinged Christmas Tree Foldable Branches - Green - 150 cm
shfd3ngh.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Hinged Christmas Tree Foldable Branches - Green - 150 cm
shfd3ngh.sourceDescription: This Modern Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree serves as a perfect addition to your festive decor, whether placed in the living room or as part of your garden festivities. Its simple, cone-shaped design offers a contemporary twist, combining minimal ornamentation with a functional approach that complements any modern interior. The adaptable nature of this tree makes it an ideal fit for both small apartments and expansive holiday settings, providing a centerpiece that captivates without overwhelming the surrounding space. High-Quality Materials Crafted from durable PVC, this tree boasts longevity and resilience, allowing it to withstand the wear of seasonal setup and storage. The PVC material gives the tree a realistic density, closely mimicking the appearance of natural fir while offering flame-resistant properties for added safety. This ensures that your decor remains both attractive and secure throughout the festive season. Effortless Lighting Equipped with LED strip lights boasting a warm white hue, the tree illuminates your space with a comforting glow. The flexible nature of these lights allows you to position them precisely, enhancing the aesthetic without the frustration of tangled wires. Designed for energy efficiency, these LEDs contribute to an economical holiday display that can brighten any room or garden. User-Friendly Assembly The tree features hinged branches that allow for straightforward assembly, requiring no additional tools besides a screwdriver for the initial setup. This design enables a hassle-free experience, letting you focus more on decoration and less on complicated processes. With clear instructions, the setup is seamless, requiring minimal effort from two people. Versatile Use Designed for both indoor and outdoor settings, this tree adapts to various holiday themes and locations. Its understated elegance allows for creative decoration —whether you're adding traditional ornaments or modern embellishments. The USB power source ensures convenient placement, without the need for proximity to a wall outlet. Care and Longevity When not in use, it is recommended to cover the tree to protect it from dust and elements, ensuring it retains its quality year after year. By following proper care instructions, you can enjoy the tree's beauty season after season without significant wear or deterioration, maintaining its novel appearance and functionality. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC and metal Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 97 cm Stand size: 50 x 50 cm Durable Lifelike branch tips Reusable, Low maintenance, Simple setup, Sturdy metal stand 8 Lighting modes: combination, in wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing/running water, slow fade, twinkle/flash and steady on This luxury tree has a hinged construction, so the branches will automatically fold down in the right angle. This will make it much easier to put up the tree in the perfect shape, and will save you time as well. Number of PVC tips: 793 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: Plug Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1xArtificialChristmastree,1xStand,1xLEDstringlight,1xPeak,20x3cmball,21x4cmball,20x6cmball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

rawve45f.sourceDescription: Create a traditional winter display with the GloBrite 2.7m Snowtipped Artificial Pine Christmas Garland. FLEXIBLE AND ADJUSTABLE: The branches can be shaped and positioned to help create a fuller display and suit different decorating spaces. DURABLE PVC MATERIAL: Made from polyvinyl chloride for a practical artificial garland that can be reused as part of seasonal decorations. INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE: Suitable for decorating a range of indoor and outdoor areas during the Christmas season. VERSATILE FESTIVE DECORATION: Ideal for combining with lights, ribbons, ornaments and other seasonal accessories to create a customised Christmas display. tw0hb913.variantName: Charles Bentley 55cm Artificial Decoration Berry Christmas  Wreath - White
tw0hb913.sourceDescription: Our 55cm White Berry Christmas Wreath brings a fresh, contemporary feel to your home – a softer, quieter take on Christmas for anyone who'd rather step away from traditional red and green. Clusters of soft white berries give a calm, refined finish that stands out against a dark internal door or a neutral wall. This wreath brings a calm, all-white palette that works across a wide range of festive styling – it sits beautifully alongside silver, gold, blush, and copper, and holds its own in a more minimal or scandi scheme. The berry clusters add texture and detail without introducing colour, keeping the overall look clean and cohesive. At 55cm in diameter, it's well-proportioned for most internal doors and interior spaces. Lightweight, easy to hang, and ready to display straight from the box. Ideal for: Internal doors, interior walls, above mantels, feature shelving, and modern, scandi, or neutral Christmas displays. Please Note: For indoor use only. Keep away from open flame and heat sources. Features: • Clusters of soft white berries – a contemporary Christmas look for any room • Neutral white palette pairs beautifully with any festive colour scheme • Ideal for creating a cohesive modern Christmas aesthetic throughout the home • Dense pliable branches that hold their shape and can be lightly shaped for a fuller appearance • Durable plastic construction – colour-fast white finish with no needle drop • Lightweight and easy to hang – no tools or assembly required • Compact to store flat between seasons Includes: • 1x White Berry Christmas Wreath Materials: • Plastic (white berries and detailing) Dimensions: H55, W55, D3.5cm • Diameter: 55cm Warning: for indoor decorative use only. Keep away from open flames, heat sources and ignition sources. Hang securely so it cannot fall. Keep small decorative parts and artificial berries away from young children and pets. Not a toy. Charles Bentley North Road, Loughborough, Leicestershire LE11 1QJ
